title: Zaccur
summary: Mindful. (1.) Father of Shammua, who was one of the spies sent out by Moses (Num. 13:4).

inlines.v: Mindful. (1.) Father of Shammua, who was one of the spies sent out by Moses (Num. 13:4).
(3.) A son of Asaph, and chief of one of the courses of singers as arranged by David (1 Chr. 25:2, 10).
